bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_static_hr_safe32_native32_1r u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv results/rtl/qw_head_safe32_1020/h16v/net_def/native32_1r_param.v results/rtl/qw_head_safe32_1020/h16v/net_def/native32_helpers.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: bench_h16w_imgh
bench.pass_regex: CTLM_PROG MUT=0 BMUT=0 HARD_HR=1 HRA=0 DECODE=3: PASS (123/123|131/131)

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16w/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16w/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16w --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_static_hr_safe32_native32_1r --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: h16t/h16u logic depth (CTS ODB TT reg->reg: dts r_q -345, fixed_issue sched_q -344, cfg_fault -300, dpre/dtilk -242, rom_cmd_q -140, program_obs -92; 40-level ripples: the gate mapping folded adds/increments/the 16 array dividers into chains). h16v RTL (exact, 0 edges; claude/qw-h16v-1020): shared log-depth DYN_TTILES quotient registered with pos_r (mod-3 KS scan) + kept KS increments; relocation bases registered with loaded_stage + kept KS 24-bit adds; fixed_issue cycle+1 / magnitude compares as kept KS; seal_bad flat-term OR tree + prefix-popcount thresholds selected by count; candidate/prog_a adds kept KS; program write observer in closed form. Netlist: same prepare_generic/bit_generic/bound_head_netlist chain, default ABC -g script (area); bounded-netlist max depth 26 levels (h16u 40). Same h16u geometry, single clock region.
